name: D.K. Enterprises Global Ltd.
summary: D.K. Enterprises Global Ltd. is an Indian packaging company that manufactures a range of packaging materials. Its primary products include paper-based packaging, self-adhesive tapes such as BOPP, banding, masking, and specialty tapes, as well as laminated products, corrugated boxes, and trays. The company also produces flexible packaging solutions like soap wrappers and pillow pouches. Operating on a business-to-business (B2B) model, D.K. Enterprises Global Ltd. supplies customized packaging to diverse sectors including fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), consumer durables, logistics, and pharmaceuticals. The company serves as a supplier to major consumer durable and logistics companies, as well as large multinational and domestic brands, primarily within India, with manufacturing facilities in Haryana, Gujarat, and Himachal Pradesh.
